title: 雪の中の動物
subject_en: winter animals in soft watercolour, each with a little snow around its feet, one animal per picture Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white.
lead: 雪の中のうさぎ・きつね・ペンギンなど、冬の動物を水彩タッチで描いた12点です。寒中見舞いや冬のお便りに使えます。
items: a white rabbit sitting in snow
a penguin with a red scarf
a sleepy bear wearing a knitted hat
an owl on a snowy branch
a squirrel holding an acorn in snow
a cat curled up at a kotatsu
a sheep wearing a knitted scarf
a hedgehog with a tiny knit cap
a snowman with a small bird on its head
